assets.name: forest-service-emblem.svg
assets.notes: Exact coloured vector linked by user. Seven independently editable shapes, manually reconstructed. No text; not an identified typeface. Badge #278F38, white map/islands #FFFFFF, tree #00240B. Three detached island shapes.

assets.name: forest-service-emblem-one-ink.svg
assets.notes: Exact monochrome study offered on same emblem page. Source-built black province/islands silhouette with negative-space conifer, and constant-width squircle border. Two detached islands. No fonts or embedded raster. Silhouette and islands are filled paths; outer frame is an unfilled path with #111111 stroke-width 13.85. No external dependencies. ViewBox 24 0 244 236; root width and height both 520. Preserve viewBox aspect ratio.

provenance_notes: Both are reference-based PofBC reconstructions, not original authenticated official vector masters.
Repository describes 1973 cessation as an unverified working date, not established history.
One-ink frame's exponent 3.25 and border width 13.85 are chosen construction parameters, not official historic specifications.
Measured overlap 92.4%/90.8% relates to its two supplied print references, not the raccoon ad; do not reuse those figures as ad comparison results.

Coloured master three islands and monochrome two islands are distinct evidence-based constructions; don't simply recolour filled badge green to black because this will not reproduce the one-ink appearance.
